events.text: Pat Sullivan born, later Australian-American cartoonist and producer
Left Australia, spent a few months in London, England

evidence.quote: before moving to the United States around 1910

events.text: Joined Raoul Barré's new animated cartoon studio

evidence.quote: When Marriner died in 1914 , Sullivan joined the new animated cartoon studio set up by Raoul Barré

events.text: Fired by Raoul Barré for general incompetence

evidence.quote: In 1915 , Sullivan was fired by Barre for general incompetence

events.label: conviction
events.text: Convicted of second-degree rape; served 9 months in prison

evidence.quote: In 1917 , Sullivan was convicted of rape in the second degree

events.text: Signed contract as animator with Paramount Studios

evidence.quote: signed a contract as an animator with Paramount Studios in March 1920

events.text: Finally agreed to use sound in Felix the Cat cartoons

evidence.quote: by late 1928 , Sullivan , after years of refusing to convert Felix to sound , finally agreed to use sound

events.text: Relented and announced Felix would return with sound

evidence.quote: Sullivan relented in 1933 , and announced that Felix would return in sound

events.label: death
events.text: Died in New York City of alcoholism and pneumonia, aged 47

evidence.quote: Sullivan died on 15 February 1933 in New York City at age 47
